candidates.hook: Seamus cries out in despair: "You are a viscount's daughter! Sleeping on straw, sorting weeds!"
candidates.cliffhanger: Catherine smiles greedily and plots: "Once the old Duchess is gone... Ashbury will finally belong to us."
candidates.why: It contrasts Juliana's noble sacrifice as a fallen viscount's daughter with Catherine's callous plot to eliminate the Duchess and take the estate.

candidates.hook: Rupert declares: "Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown... the title is mine."
candidates.cliffhanger: Rupert reveals he is secretly murdering the Dowager Duchess: "Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort."
candidates.why: Instantly establishes the usurpation plot and delivers a chilling reveal that the Dowager is actively being poisoned.

candidates.hook: Catherine sneers: "Let the peasants rot in their barns. Let them pray to their weeds."
candidates.cliffhanger: Catherine glides to the window and vows: "This house will only bow to me."
candidates.why: A short, punchy villain showcase that establishes pure contempt for the sick villagers and an impending takeover of the estate.

moments.desc: Rupert declares he will take the title once Alexander is declared dead and gloats over the Dowager's failing health.
Seamus laments Juliana living like a peasant while Juliana defiantly refuses to abandon the sick villagers.
Catherine plots the Dowager's death and proclaims that Ashbury Manor will only bow to her.
